newsitem.title: USA: G&L Realty agrees on $200 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: G&L Realty agrees on $200 mln financing.

text.p: G&L Realty Corp said Tuesday it has reached an agreement in principle with Nomura Asset Capital Corp to enter into a venture to provide $200 million in financing to the senior care industry.
The venture is expected to allow G&L to expand its senior care division without diluting shareholders' equity.
Details about the financing were not available.
The company said in a statement the deal would allow it to build long term growth in funds from operations.
G&L's senior care division finances and facilitates the sale of skilled nursing and assisted care facilities to organizations throughout the U.S.
